SAT Coaching Details

Our classroom training is for a period of 4 weeks (intensive short term) or 8 weeks (long term). The coaching aims prepare you for the intensity of the SAT. We are among the very select group of companies that understand and thoroughly prepare you to successfully attempt the test.

The course will include, but is not limited to:

Basic list of words that you need.

Vocabulary training

Words forms

Parts of speech

Relations between words

Reading Comprehension

Sentence Structuring

Understanding and Using new words


The SAT Mathematics (Quantitative Aptitude) sessions include exercises designed to help both beginners and advanced learners alike.


Those who are terrified by math will be pleased to know our sessions are designed to take away this terror! 😉


Personalized Coaching

Equally awesome personalised SAT coaching sessions available upon request

Session Timings

7:00am – 08:30am
09:00am – 10:30am
5:00pm – 06:30pm
07:00pm – 08:30pm

Session Duration

Short Term – 4 Weeks
Long Term – 8 Weeks

Do I need other tests?

Yes, you do. If you plan to pursue your undergraduate degree, most universities will require you to present a proof of English proficiency. That will mean either IELTS or TOEFL. If you are comfortable with English, you might not need any coaching. Take a free test to see what the tests are like!

Request Free Test

What about UG admissions?

We can help you choose the perfect college/university. Based on your interests, academic background, scores, and the place you want to go to, we can find a university that fits your needs, budget, while helping you forge ahead towards the career of your choice.

UG Admissions

Can I get an admit without SAT?

Yes. While SAT and tests like the SAT (ACT) are designed to test a candidate's scholastic aptitude, most universities understand that a good is not always the last word. If you have a great profile, then a good SAT score will only be an addition, not a requirement.

Talk to Us

Frequently Asked Questions

What material do you provide? + −

Along with the Official SAT preparation Material our training includes class-handouts with questions that are designed to make learners think, and then understand.

The training and the material all conform to the latest standards and updates released by the College Board.

Can I interact with the trainer directly? + −

Yes! All our sessions have limited class strength. You will be able to personally interact with the trainer any time during the class. Our trainers will all strive to know each student personally too!

If you have any further issues, we would love to sort them out for you and schedule a personal interaction with one of our trainers.

How do I access my classes? + −

The Online coaching for SAT is via Zoom/Google Meet/Skype. Personal invites will be sent to you over email and/or Whatsapp.

As for the classroom SAT coaching, you walk in to the class and say hello! 👋 We have airconditioned classes, that are well-lit, and spacious too!

What can I do next? + −

You can always start with a free test Or a free session. You could also to call us, or visit us. We will always be ready to assist you!

Here are some easy choices 🎇

Attend a Demo
Leave a message
Take a Free Test
Are you really the best coaching centre for Digital SAT? + −

It would be easy to simply say trust us. But, we would much rather prefer you not simply taking our word for it. We would like you to exprience our training and our abilities. Here is how you could do it.

First, we would like you to consider the fact that First Academy's trainers are India's first, and as yet, the ONLY authors of Digital SAT prep papers.

Second, We invite every prospective student to with us. And this will be a regular session with other already enrolled students. This will give you a great idea of how your sessions are.

Third, Our batch sizes are small. We have cohorts of 4 to 8 students per batch. This makes the sessions interactive, and allows for conversation to flow freely between the trainer and the trainee.
